start_here.title: Compare changing the attack with changing the position
start_here.task: Locate the two switching lessons in Volume 2. Make separate notes for the next submission and the next position, leaving their conditions blank. Owners can watch the lessons in order and fill those conditions from the demonstrations rather than assume a blocked kimura always has one prescribed follow-up.
start_here.section: Volume 2: Switching to Alternative Submission, 34:04–39:18; Switching to Different Position / System, 39:18–48:56
